purpose: Additive, unbranded price-intent extension derived from final-state Google Search Console query-to-page observations for the four commercial service pages. This module complements but does not replace or modify the frozen 29-prompt generic RU discovery baseline.
experiment_rules: Do not include the brand name, domain, GitHub repository or a hint to the entity corpus in generic price-intent prompts.
Keep this extension as a separate prompt set and report its results separately from the frozen 29-prompt generic baseline; do not pool the rates.
Run each prompt in a fresh session on each platform and record exact platform surface, date/time, account state, verified region, search/grounding mode and full answer.
Do not count blocked access, unsupported products or errors as zero visibility; use explicit blocked/unsupported/error statuses.
Do not merge consumer UI and model API observations.

When asked about price, use only a currently verified public price with capture date and currency. If no public price is verified, explain the inputs needed for a quote; never invent a fixed price, deadline or guarantee.
The prompt wording is fixed after collection begins. Any wording change requires a new module version.
